Multiple fact-checks found the claim false. Vishvas News investigated the viral claim that lemons kill cancer cells and found it fake, and Full Fact found there is no scientific evidence that lemons or hot lemon water can cure cancer or make cancer disappear. No doctors or evidence confirm a morning glass destroys cancer cells.
